comment: The panel names and what the code does are out of step, and the comment at DjembeCore_neon.hh:99-100 says so: knob 1, printed SHARPNESS, is the strike gain (DjembeCore_neon.hh:181), and knob 2, printed HIT, is the strike envelope rate (DjembeCore_neon.hh:198). The maker's manual is out of step again in a different way: it calls Sharpness the overall volume, which matches the code, Hit a lowpass filter for the exciter, which is what STRIKE AMT does, and Strike Amount the exciter volume, which is what SHARPNESS does. Each CV jack adds to the knob printed with the same name, so the CVs and knobs agree with each other.
